name: PDF to Images
summary: Convert PDF pages to PNG or JPEG images in your browser — no upload required.
description: Drop a PDF, pick resolution and format, choose all pages or a range, and download each page as an image. Rendering uses PDF.js locally on your device. Encrypted PDFs are not supported.

faqs.question: Is my PDF uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Pages are rendered with PDF.js entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Why is there a page limit?
faqs.answer: Rendering many high-DPI pages can exhaust browser memory. Select a range of up to 40 pages per run.

faqs.question: PNG or JPEG?
faqs.answer: PNG keeps sharp text and transparency. JPEG is smaller for photo-heavy pages.
